meta.title: Lëkurësi Castle – Sarandë, Albania
meta.description: Complete travel guide to Lëkurësi Castle (Kalaja e Lëkurësit) in Sarandë, Albania. Learn about this 16th-century fortress, including its history, sunset views, restaurant, and visitor information.

intro.title: Discover Lëkurësi Castle
intro.description: Lëkurësi Castle (Kalaja e Lëkurësit) is a 16th-century ruined fortress perched on a strategic hilltop overlooking Sarandë, Albania. Built in 1537 by Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent, the castle offers breathtaking panoramic views of the city, the Ionian Sea, and the island of Corfu. Today, it stands as a popular landmark and a stunning viewpoint, especially renowned for its spectacular sunsets.

visitGuide.title: Visit Tips
items: Perfect for photography, particularly at sunset.
Dine at the restaurant inside the castle walls with an open terrace.
The hilltop offers a near-360° panorama of Saranda bay and Butrint Lake.
Access via a scenic paved road, either by car, taxi, or a hike.

alsoKnownAs.title: Highlights
items: Breathtaking views of Saranda and Corfu
On-site restaurant and traditional music in summer

sections.title: History & Heritage
sections.content: Built in 1537 by Ottoman Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent during his campaign against Corfu, the castle was designed to protect the harbor of Saranda and the road to Butrint. It originally housed a garrison of 220 soldiers. The castle later became a refuge and was eventually abandoned after 1878, losing its military role.

sections.title: Architecture & Structure
sections.content: The castle has a roughly square plan with two large round towers located at the northwestern and southeastern corners. Its imposing stone walls are approximately 2 meters thick and reach up to 7 meters high, showcasing classic 16th-century limestone masonry.

sections.title: Location & Landscape
sections.content: Situated on Lekursi Hill, southeast of Saranda's center, the fortress commands an unparalleled vantage point. The slopes around the castle are dotted with olive trees and Mediterranean maquis scrub, creating a picturesque natural setting.

sections.title: Modern Significance
sections.content: Following partial restorations in the 20th and 21st centuries, Lëkurësi Castle has transformed into Saranda's principal viewpoint. The interior now houses a popular restaurant, making it a vibrant cultural and tourist hub, especially during summer evenings.

items.question: What are the opening hours of Lëkurësi Castle?
items.answer: The castle ruins are open 24/7 and entry is free. The restaurant inside operates during lunch and evening hours, typically staying open late.

items.question: Is there an entrance fee?
items.answer: No, exploring the castle ruins and enjoying the panoramic views is completely free to the public.

items.question: How do I get to the castle from Saranda?
items.answer: It is a 10-minute drive by car or taxi from the city center. You can also walk up the paved road, which takes about 45-60 minutes, though it can be steep and hot in summer.

items.question: Are there facilities or restaurants on-site?
items.answer: Yes, there is a large restaurant located right inside the castle walls offering Albanian and Mediterranean cuisine, drinks, and incredible views from its terrace.

hours.title: Visiting Hours
hours.bestTimeSpring: Spring: Pleasant weather and clear views
hours.bestTimeSummer: Summer: Vibrant atmosphere and live music in the evening
hours.bestTimeAutumn: Autumn: Cooler temperatures, perfect for hiking up
hours.tip: Visit about an hour before sunset for the most spectacular lighting and views across the Ionian Sea.

tickets.title: Admission Information
tickets.parkingPrice: Free parking available at the top
tickets.guidedPrice: Included in many Saranda day tours

transport.title: How to Get Here
transport.fromCenterDesc: A taxi ride from Saranda center takes about 10-15 minutes and costs approximately 5-10 EUR (500-1000 LEK).
transport.fromStationDesc: About a 10-15 minute taxi ride from the Saranda Ferry Terminal directly to the castle.
transport.fromAirportDesc: Travel to Saranda by bus (from Tirana) or ferry (from Corfu), then take a taxi to the hilltop.
transport.publicTransportDesc: There are no direct public buses up the hill. Taxis are the most convenient option.
transport.walkingDesc: A 45-60 minute uphill hike via a paved switchback road. Bring plenty of water in the summer!
transport.drivingDesc: The road up is paved and in good condition. Free parking is available right at the summit.

route.title: Recommended Route
route.overview: Experience the best of Lëkurësi Castle and its breathtaking surroundings.
steps: Start from Saranda city center or promenade
Take a taxi or drive up the scenic winding road to Lekursi Hill
Explore the ruined walls and round towers of the fortress
Take photos of the panoramic views of Saranda bay and Corfu
Relax with a drink or dinner at the castle restaurant during sunset

items.name: James W.
items.text: Absolutely stunning views! Watching the sunset over Saranda and Corfu from the castle walls is an unforgettable experience.

items.name: Sophia M.
items.text: Great historical site with an amazing restaurant inside. The atmosphere with live Albanian music in the summer was fantastic.

items.name: Andreas K.
items.text: The walk up is quite steep and hot, but the panoramic views at the top are completely worth it. A must-visit in Saranda!

items.name: Emma L.
items.text: Beautiful ruined castle. It's free to enter and explore. We had a lovely dinner at the terrace overlooking the city.

items.name: Michael R.
items.text: A wonderful place to take photos. The 16th-century walls are impressive, and the view of the bay is breathtaking.

items.name: Linda T.
items.text: One of the best viewpoints in Albania. Make sure to come here during golden hour for the best lighting.
